alcohol.answer: Air France allows alcohol in checked baggage (5 litres per person for drinks of 24% to 70%) but not in the cabin, except duty-free alcohol bought after security and kept in a sealed bag. Homemade alcohol and anything above 70% are not allowed.

sections.h: 🍷 What Air France says about alcohol

faq: Can I take alcohol in my Air France cabin bag?
Not normally. The exception is alcohol bought in a duty-free shop at the airport after security and kept in a sealed bag.
How much alcohol can I check on Air France?
Up to 5 litres per person for drinks between 24% and 70% alcohol; drinks above 70% and homemade alcohol are not allowed.
